app.title: Visual Analysis of Binary Files
app.author: vismit2000
app.description: A web-based binary file visualizer that renders byte-level patterns and metadata using WebGL.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo, run `npm install` and `npm run build`.
Serve the application and open a known binary (e.g., a small ELF) to ensure the visualization loads.
Run a headless browser test to capture the rendered canvas and compare against a stored baseline.
Measure load time and memory usage for a 1 MB binary.
